f.n: Hamelin Pool Marine Nature Reserve
f.pu: To protect the world-renowned stromatolites and is one of only two places in the world with living examples of this ancient cyanobacteria organism.
f.re: 1. No fishing is permitted. 2. Boating, anchoring, swimming, diving and snorkelling is not permitted over stromatolites or within 300m of the shore in the Hamelin Pool Marine Nature Reserve. Boats are not to be run ashore over marine algal mats or stromatolites in the reserve. 3. Motorised water sports.
